title: Improved error handling and reliability
summary: Agent loop now handles LLM failures and malformed tool calls gracefully instead of crashing.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Agent now returns user-facing error messages instead of crashing silently on API timeouts and failures
Malformed tool arguments from the model are now handled gracefully without breaking the agent loop
Tool execution failures (S3, external APIs) are now reported to the model as errors instead of crashing
